limitations: 160dB@1m gun source is tuning: M16157dBSPL reference measurement location is not verified as1m. MIL-STD1474 criterion is not treated as source power. AK has no original recording.

Mass-law form20log10(surfaceMass*frequency)-47 uses nominal material densities and a conventional approximate intercept: this is an engineering game model, not measured transmission/STC data. OSHA verifies mechanism, not the -47 intercept.
Maekawa bibliographic record verified; primary full paper not acquired. Fresnel detour/angle weighting is explicitly tuning, not a reproduced1968 empirical fit.
Absorption table is an engineering reference table; actual map assemblies/surfaces are unknown. Acoustic ceiling and surface-area fitting are tuning.
Crack amplitude/duration are tuning; no Whitham calibrated pressure law is claimed. Local Mach geometry uses actual completed trajectory speeds.
TTS dose/loss/recovery and masking are game tuning, not an auditory-injury predictor. Source recovery16–48h; game dose time constant18s.
